title: Three-coordinate majority with two fixed inputs
statement: Let $i,j$ be distinct positions among three coordinates, and let $a,b,s$ be signs with $a\ne b$. The majority of the vector whose $i$th entry is $a$, whose $j$th entry is $b$, and whose remaining entry is $s$ equals $s$.
